name: Shifter
traits: Medium Humanoid with the Shapechanger subtype. Base land speed 30 ft. +2 Dexterity, −2 Intelligence, −2 Charisma. The setting entry gives no racial Hit Dice or level adjustment.
Low-light vision doubles human range and preserves color and detail. +2 racial on Balance, Climb, and Jump.
Common is automatic. Bonus languages are Elven, Gnome, Halfling, and Sylvan. Favored class Ranger.

Shifting (Su) is a free action once per day. It lasts 3 rounds + the current Constitution modifier, counting an increase from shifting. Each shifter feat adds one round per use, and each pair of shifter feats adds one daily use.
Choose one of the six original traits at character creation. Its active benefits apply while shifting. Shifting is innate and cannot be transmitted by bites or claws.
Beasthide gives +2 Constitution and a +2 natural armor bonus to AC.
Cliffwalk gives +2 Dexterity and a climb speed of 20 ft.
Longstride gives +2 Dexterity and +10 ft. to base land speed.

Longtooth gives +2 Strength and a bite with a printed base die of 1d6 and +1 damage per four character levels. Bite once per round. When paired with a weapon, the bite is a secondary natural attack with −5 on the bite attack roll and half the Strength bonus to damage.

Razorclaw gives +2 Strength and two primary claws with printed base damage 1d4 +1 per four character levels per claw. Use one claw as a standard action or both as a full attack. Each claw attacks at most once per round. In the first printing, using a claw as a light off-hand weapon with a manufactured primary weapon applies −2 to all attacks that round.
Wildhunt gives +2 Constitution and scent while shifting. Outside shifting, Wildhunt gives +2 to Survival checks.

Wildhunt scent detects a creature at 30 ft., 60 ft. upwind, or 15 ft. downwind. Double those ranges for strong odors and triple them for overpowering odors. A move action identifies direction. Within 5 ft., pinpoint the source.

While shifting, a Wildhunt Shifter with Track can follow scent using Survival. A typical fresh trail is DC 10 and adds +2 per hour, with adjustments for odor and group size. Ignore surface and poor-visibility modifiers.
